name: Teresa
source:
A dark-skinned maid who looks after Urumi in the imperial castle.

She also cooperates with Urumi’s escape plan, but because of her position she often finds herself caught between the empire and Urumi. She has a bright, caring personality, but she is a bit of a pushover and easily swept along. Because of that, she sometimes ends up receiving treatment she never expected.

Source:  [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/kaizou_prison.html]Official Webiste[/url]
